description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which wraps Android's native Log utility to implement a logging interface and support chaining of log nodes. It is a utility class used for logging within an Android application, and it facilitates outputting log messages with additional customization.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements the LogNode interface, providing a wrapper around Android's native Log utility and allowing chaining of log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable, then passes it along the chain.
